spatial_problem.zh: 测试活动与全天公众通行冲突。
spatial_problem.en: Controlled testing conflicts with all-day public passage.

operation_windows.zh: 公众旁路 24 小时；机器人测试建议仅 10:00–12:00 / 14:00–16:00，并由现场许可复核
operation_windows.en: Public bypass 24/7; robot trial proposed only 10:00–12:00 / 14:00–16:00, subject to site approval

scale_note.zh: 概念比例，待官方底图复核
scale_note.en: Concept scale; verify against official base

spatial_problem.zh: 专业服务门槛与社区日常穿行割裂。
spatial_problem.en: Professional service thresholds sever everyday public passage.

operation_windows.zh: 公共大厅按普通开放时间运行；AI 导航仅在双语人工台在岗时开放
operation_windows.en: The hall follows ordinary opening hours; AI navigation opens only while the bilingual staffed desk is available

scale_note.zh: 概念比例，待官方底图复核
scale_note.en: Concept scale; verify against official base

spatial_problem.zh: 轨道接驳、日常广场与限时试验争夺同一前场。
spatial_problem.en: Transit, daily plaza life and timed trials compete for one forecourt.

operation_windows.zh: 常规接驳全天优先；低速试验建议避开高峰并限于单次 20 分钟受控窗口
operation_windows.en: Conventional interchange always has priority; low-speed trials avoid peaks and use controlled 20-minute windows

scale_note.zh: 原型设计假设，待测绘、站口、道路红线、消防、管线和交通组织复核
scale_note.en: Prototype design assumption pending survey, station-exit, road-line, fire, utility and traffic verification

spatial_signature.zh: 公共十字不断线，AI 只进入东南可逆试验湾，城市决定留在西南证据门廊。
spatial_signature.en: The public cross stays continuous, AI enters only the southeast reversible bay, and the civic decision remains at the southwest evidence porch.

daily_operation_steps.zh: 开场检查公共十字、盲道、坡道、照明和人工岗位。
daily_operation_steps.en: Opening check of public cross, tactile guidance, ramps, lighting and staffed posts.

daily_operation_steps.zh: 普通接驳独立运行并建立非识别基线记录。
daily_operation_steps.en: Conventional interchange runs independently and establishes a non-identifying baseline log.

daily_operation_steps.zh: 许可与检查表齐全后，在东南湾开启单次受控试验。
daily_operation_steps.en: After permits and checks are complete, open one controlled trial in the southeast bay.

daily_operation_steps.zh: 触发停止时设备停机、人工完成任务、公共十字保持开放。
daily_operation_steps.en: On a stop trigger, equipment halts, staff complete the task and the public cross stays open.

daily_operation_steps.zh: 闭场前对照普通与试验记录，回执保持采用、修改或停止三选一。
daily_operation_steps.en: Before close, compare baseline and trial logs; the receipt remains adopt, revise or stop only.

daily_operation_steps.zh: 设备经撤场线进入存储或供应商回收，试验湾恢复普通用途。
daily_operation_steps.en: Equipment follows the removal route to storage or supplier return; the bay returns to ordinary use.

usage_note.en: Conceptual spatial layout under provisional boundaries; not a survey, statutory plan, road redline or approval basis.

subtitle.zh: 城市采纳编译器：把每项 AI 空间方案编译为完整公共路线、可触发停止机制和可复核回执。
subtitle.en: Civic Adoption Compiler: compile every AI spatial proposal into a complete public route, triggerable stop mechanism and reviewable receipt.

design_scale_note.en: All scales and dimensions are concept-design proposals based on public sources, pending survey, ownership, fire, utility and official-base verification

projection_method: Local equirectangular rendering around each concept station; GeoJSON remains WGS84.

honor_display_rule.zh: 只登记任务、复现条件、许可、失败原因、证据等级和人工决定；不设置企业广告排行榜。
honor_display_rule.en: Record task, reproducibility conditions, licence, failure reason, evidence level and human decision only; no promotional ranking.

honor_display_rule.zh: 公开问题、人工复核和可复用知识包，不展示未经复核的模型自评分。
honor_display_rule.en: Display public questions, human review and reusable knowledge packs, never unreviewed model self-scores.

honor_display_rule.zh: 回执只允许 adopt、revise、stop，并记录复核日期、申诉入口和退出资产。
honor_display_rule.en: Receipts allow adopt, revise or stop only and record review date, appeal access and exit assets.
